pr_title: Modify install plan to support all distribution types
pr_body:
This PR adds caching support for built wheels in the installer. Specifically, the `RegistryWheelIndex` now indexes both downloaded and built wheels (from registries), and we have a new `BuiltWheelIndex` that takes a subdirectory and returns the "best-matching" compatible wheel.

Closes #570.
pr_comments: (Not going rogue, Konsti gave me the sign-off to merge once feedback was addressed.)

issue_context.title: Respect built wheels when composing the install plan
issue_context.body: Right now, built wheels are entirely ignored, which leads to bugs like #554 and workarounds like #545.

review_comments: But that's installing a wheel, not a built source dist, isn't it?
Correct! We already have a separate test for direct URL wheels. (I forgot to add this variant in the earlier PR.)
